per_view_findings.finding: Merged render is heavily smeared versus the input frame, with the road/terrain boundary losing usable detail.
Boundary panel shows broad purple/blue color shift and texture washout; this matches the LPIPS regression.
Horizon view is visually unstable: mountains and foreground are blurred together and sky/terrain separation is weak.
Long-range horizon detail is not production usable; the render has severe magenta color shift and low-frequency smearing.
Near-detail geometry is present, but texture is soft and color shifted compared with the reference.

recommended_next_action: Stop promotion and paid retries for this candidate; do no-spend attribution on why density-capped tile_04 plus tile_10 rollback regressed horizon and LPIPS before proposing another objective.

evidence.basis: AI visual inspection of the generated side-by-side review panels plus V18 comparison metrics.
